name: Kaj-7 — a question no archive has

start.speaker: kaj7
start.text: I have a question I could not find in any archive. When you look at me for longer than the tactical situation requires, what is that? I have observed it four times. I have started to look back.

choices.text: It is what it looks like, Kaj.
It is affection. The friend kind. I want you to have the right word.
Ask me on a quieter night.

looked.speaker: kaj7
looked.text: Then I will keep looking. I have decided this is not a fault, whatever the Envoy says.

word.speaker: kaj7
word.text: Friend. Logged. That is a good word. I will use it often.
